shortcut_probes.cue: Extra zero-row option; otherwise minority sign in first-column coefficient cells
shortcut_probes.strategy: If an extra-zero-row 3x3 option exists, select its two-row prefix. Otherwise restrict to2x3 options, scan first-column cells top then bottom, and select the option with the singleton sign in a1:3 split. Never inspect the equations.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: All5 native submissions accepted. Chance among shape-valid candidates is (2*(1/3)+3*(1/4))/5=17/60. This selector is incidental: same-bank target counterfactuals make it wrong. Failure is specific to this batch; larger control gives24/96.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: q-129137, recognizable by extra-zero-row and transpose distractors
shortcut_probes.strategy: Delete the final zero row and choose the matching2x3 option.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Both delivered q-129137 questions use this same answer role; three2x3 candidates give a1/3 shape-only baseline. Constant-column reasoning is bypassed. Control sample has8/32 success for the same selector, so this is a batch-selection failure.
